platforms.name: KRFC 88.9 FM Public Upload Form and Physical Music Submission Route
platforms.country: United States / Fort Collins, Colorado community-radio digital and physical music-submission route
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee is stated; physical-media production and shipping costs apply if the postal route is used.
platforms.manualReviewReason: KRFC's official form requires release metadata, a streaming link, an MP3 or WAV upload and a one-sheet upload, and it includes a hidden validation/honeypot field that must not be manipulated. A human must verify clean FCC-safe edits and rights, prepare the metadata and files, complete the public form normally or choose the physical-CD route, and avoid duplicate delivery.
platforms.notes: The official KRFC submission page was verified on 2026-07-11. It welcomes music across genres, requests artist and release details, focus tracks and regional tour dates, supports MP3/WAV and one-sheet uploads with a stated 300 MB maximum per file, and also publishes a physical CD route addressed to the Music Director. No form was submitted, no hidden field was touched and no package was prepared.

platforms.name: Radio Boise KRBX Public Dynamic Music Submission Form Route
platforms.country: United States / Boise, Idaho community-radio dynamic music-submission form route
platforms.manualReviewReason: Radio Boise explicitly routes artists to its official Submit Your Music page, but the embedded form loads dynamically and its current fields, file/link rules, declarations and any runtime human-verification controls are not exposed in the static page. A human must inspect and complete the live form normally, confirm all requirements and avoid using the general station email as a substitute submission route.
platforms.notes: The official Radio Boise homepage, contact page and Submit Your Music page were verified on 2026-07-11. The contact page explicitly directs music submissions to the official form and publishes the general info address only for station contact. The current site includes a June 22, 2026 station post and active programming. No form was submitted and no general-contact email was used.

platforms.name: WNCW 88.7 Music Director Digital and Physical Submission Route
platforms.country: United States / Spindale, North Carolina public-radio digital and physical music-submission route
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee is stated; physical-media production and shipping costs apply if the CD route is used.
platforms.manualReviewReason: WNCW prefers mailed CDs but also accepts digital WAV or MP3 delivery to the publicly listed Music Director address through a common downloadable service such as Dropbox or Google Drive. A human must choose one route, prepare a concise one-sheet, verify release rights and file accessibility, select focus material and handle any physical shipping; airplay is not guaranteed.
platforms.notes: The official WNCW submission page was verified on 2026-07-11. It publishes martin@wncw.org for digital-only submissions, accepts singles, EPs and full-length releases, asks that physical submissions be mailed rather than delivered in person, and provides a Music Director postal address. The site publishes current new-release coverage dated July 6-9, 2026. No email, download link, file or CD was sent.

platforms.name: KZMU Moab Public Music and Programming Director Pre-Submission Inquiry Route
platforms.country: United States / Moab, Utah community-radio Music and Programming Director inquiry route
platforms.feeAmount: No inquiry or submission fee is stated.
platforms.manualReviewReason: KZMU publicly lists its Music and Programming Director and business email, but the current official site does not publish an unsolicited-music submission policy, accepted formats, attachment or download-link rules, release windows or required metadata. A human must first send only a concise routing inquiry without audio files or track links and wait for explicit authorization and delivery instructions.
platforms.notes: The official KZMU contact, staff, homepage and Fresh Tracks pages were verified on 2026-07-11. They publish Cozy Soul as Music and Programming Director at cozy@kzmu.org and show current music activity, including a July 8, 2026 station news item and recent Fresh Tracks additions. The public role address was not treated as blanket permission to deliver assets, and no inquiry was sent.
